title: Grateful Dead Live at Springer's Inn Portland on 1970-01-16
source: restoration of source ID 7111; see info file for details

ai_review.summary: Good soundboard recording with early roughness but a strong later half that delivers hot renditions of Easy Wind, Dire Wolf and a stellar Uncle John's Band intro.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its energetic second‑half performances – especially Easy Wind, Dire Wolf, Anthem of the Sun and an inspired Uncle John's Band guitar intro – while the first fifteen tracks suffer from slightly fast playback and lower fidelity. The soundboard source has been cleaned up, yielding a generally clear and listenable recording despite some early‑set issues.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show 4–5 stars and highlight several standout songs, while noting only minor recording flaws in the early portion; this yields a high overall rating with moderate confidence given four reviews.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Early tracks sound fast and a bit muddy, but cleanup work improves the last ten tracks to clear, balanced sound; overall the SBD is listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First half feels rushed and sonically thin, but the second half picks up momentum with tighter playing and strong song selections, delivering a satisfying overall arc.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar intro to Uncle John's Band highlighted as impressive; reviewer quotes Jerry linking it to Morning Dew.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drum segment noted within the Crypitcal>Drums>Other One>Cryptical sequence, indicating solid rhythmic work.
